whats_new: Sizing Weaver: a new weaver type for a party who weaves on a beam you have sized. Their yarn now comes off stock as the TDS card's weft weight scaled to the taka's metres — a card reading 10.132 kg / 110m works out to 10.593 kg over 115 metres — instead of the whole taka weight being deducted

Every quality a Sizing Weaver weaves must have a TDS card of the same design name. The app says so when you pick the weaver, and stops the entry if the card is missing, so a taka can never be costed at nothing
The old "Sizing" party type is now called "Sizers" — the unit that sizes your beams — so it is never read as a Sizing Weaver. Open those parties in Masters once and re-pick the type
Fabric Qualities no longer asks for a warping method; the weaver's type decides how a taka is worked out. The window is now titled Add / Edit Fabric Quality (Warping Method)

Cards (TDS): a card now records the metres its weights are quoted for and shows them in a new TAPE column. Changing the tape lengths in Settings can no longer change what an already-saved card means — open and save each card once to stamp its own metres, marked with a "?" until you do
Cards (TDS) fix: typing a yarn name instead of picking it from the list was refused on save with "Select a yarn for warp row 4", even though the row was showing a weight

Assign Beams now looks at Weaver Warping and Sizing beams as well as Office. Beams the weaver had warped were invisible to it, so it reported "Auto-assigned 0 entries" against a register full of matching beams — and it now says why anything was left unassigned, naming the beams that carry that design on another loom
Production: right-click any taka to assign, change or clear its beam. The beam picker was only reachable if you knew to click the BEAM NO cell
Masters: "Yarn Formulas" is now "Yarn Twister Formulas"
Settings: the sizing metres setting is now "Sizing Weaver — metres used" and spells out what it changes

Cards (TDS): opening a card in “Enter Weight Directly” mode showed the calculated column headings (Total Ends / Wt / % of Warp) over the single weight box, and the warp/weft totals stayed at 0.000 however much weight was typed — both fixed
Production template: TARGET WT no longer shows 0.000 on every unused row
Office Stock: YARN NAME and MILL NAME no longer shrink to a sliver on smaller screens — they keep a readable width and the number columns scroll instead

Important fix: saving a Yarn Purchase, Paavti, Yarn Dyeing, Yarn Twister or Office Warping entry could fail with "no such column: physical_session_id". Saving works normally again — just install this update, nothing to do to your data
Fixed: saving a TDS card could fail the same way
Add/Edit Purchase Bill: the column headings now line up with the boxes below them on smaller screens, and the window opens wide enough to show every column
Trader mode: choose exactly which modules appear in the sidebar, with Trader / Manufacturer / Everything presets — one app for both trading and manufacturing

Brokers & brokerage: a Brokers/Agents master, brokerage on sales and purchases (% of bill, % of taxable using a tax %, or a flat amount, and who bears it), pending-to-pay per agent, clear-till-date settlement and a top-agent view
Grey in Dyeing: see greige still lying out at dyeing houses with days-out ageing
Trader Reports: quality-colour pivot, party buy/sell, stock ageing with a dead-stock flag, and top agents

Roll / Putha packing: cut bulk finish into retail rolls, track them by location (also shown as a Roll/Putha tab in Fabric Stock), transfer rolls between locations, and dispatch on delivery challans that convert into bills
Purchase Order form: share a Purchase Order PDF with your supplier, just like the Sale Order form

Fixes: roll transfers and delivery challans now pick from real stock (with an over-stock warning); deleting a sale reverts its delivery challan to pending billing; broker deletion is guarded across sales and purchases; new brokers typed on a bill are added to the master; brokerage on flat amounts no longer resets when you edit a bill
General improvements and bug fixes.
Each party's saved address and default credit period now sync to the phone, so they show on the ledger in the Vyora app
Long ledgers can print just their oldest bills — totals stay exact
Ledger details now show the party's address and default credit period as saved in Tally
Average pay cycle: see how many days a party actually takes to pay — on the Outstanding list and above their bills, alongside the oldest bill due

Mark a bill as received while your accountant is yet to enter it in Tally — it comes off your outstanding and stays out of reminders, then clears itself once the entry lands (switch it on in Settings)
Items Stock can now be shared as a PDF — everything in one go kept group-wise, or just the group you are viewing
The version shown on the dashboard now always matches the app you have installed
Address and credit period need the Vyora Sync desktop agent on 2.0.33 or newer
